body.zh-Hant: 據 Robert A. Vitas 為 Alfonsas Eidintas 傳記專書所寫的書評，斯梅托納出身寒微，卻憑教育機會投身民族主義與政治活動；他的信念在學生時期成形，並因此一度入沙皇的監獄，日後在總統任內才見成果，例如維陶塔斯大公五百週年紀念活動。
body.en: According to Robert A. Vitas's review of Alfonsas Eidintas's biography, Smetona was born into modest means yet used his education to enter nationalist and political activism. His beliefs crystallized in his student years, which in time led to czarist prisons, and reached fruition while he was president, for example in the 500th anniversary commemorations of Vytautas the Great.

heading.zh-Hant: 立陶宛國家委員會主席與君主制提案
heading.en: Chairman of the Council and the monarchy proposal

body.zh-Hant: 在立陶宛（國家）委員會中，斯梅托納任主席。1918年7月11日下午的會議上，他代表主席團提議立陶宛採立憲君主制，並選符騰堡公爵烏拉赫為立陶宛國王明道加斯二世；他與多數右派委員認為選王不必等制憲議會，委員會自己即可進行。他堅持會議延長，務必當日解決此案，並獲多數支持。
body.en: On the Council of Lithuania, Smetona was chairman. At the afternoon sitting of 11 July 1918 he proposed, in the name of the presidium, a constitutional monarchy and the election of the Duke of Urach of Württemberg as King Mindaugas II. He and most right-wing members held that the Council itself could elect a king without waiting for a constituent assembly. He insisted that the sitting be prolonged to settle the question that same day, and a majority backed him.

body.zh-Hant: 1926年12月17日政變之後，立陶宛建立起威權統治：農民民粹黨與社會民主黨被逐出權力，總統斯梅托納掌權。塔莫沙伊蒂斯稱他為民族主義者領袖，說他是威權統治的主要建築師，而民族主義者聯盟（Lietuvių tautininkų sąjunga）受他節制。1929年秋他免去瓦爾德馬拉斯的職務；1940年6月15日蘇聯占領立陶宛，他被迫離開權力。
body.en: After the coup of 17 December 1926 authoritarian rule took hold in Lithuania: the Peasant Populists and Social Democrats were pushed out of power and President Smetona took over. Tamošaitis calls him the leader of the nationalists and the chief architect of the authoritarian regime, and the Lithuanian Nationalist Union was subordinate to him. In autumn 1929 he removed Voldemaras from his posts; on 15 June 1940 the Soviet occupation of Lithuania forced him out of power.

body.en: Vitas's review says Smetona considered himself a devout and faithful Catholic and describes him as a humanist who believed in order, an authoritarian who rejected fascism. It also treats his relationship with Voldemaras and the latter's Iron Wolf paramilitary organization, and the 1926 coup and its aftermath.

body.zh-Hant: 文森出生於太子港，畢業於太子港法學院，並取得巴黎法學與政治學博士。他曾任巴黎、柏林的公使館秘書，1912至1916年間擔任多項外交職務；也曾任太子港市議員、後任市長，期間在1904至1908年之間。1917年他出任被解散的參議院議長，其後重操律師業，並與薩農、托比共創愛國聯盟。1930年1月他創辦《海地日報》，作為競選的利器。
body.en: Vincent was born in Port-au-Prince, graduated from the Port-au-Prince law school and took a doctorate in law and political science in Paris. He was legation secretary in Paris and Berlin and held various diplomatic posts between 1912 and 1916. He served as councillor and then mayor of Port-au-Prince between 1904 and 1908. In 1917 he was president of the dispersed Senate, then returned to the bar and, with Sannon and Thoby, founded the Patriotic Union. In January 1930 he founded Haïti Journal as the vehicle of his campaign.

body.zh-Hant: 1930年11月，文森由國民議會選為總統；使館資料說他在第四輪投票以30票對19票勝過最接近的對手西穆爾·普拉德爾，任期五年。Gale 的拉丁美洲百科條目也說他靠反對美國占領取得總統職位。1935年6月2日他再度當選，這次以普選方式，一部交付公民投票的憲法使總統任期自動延長五年。
body.en: In November 1930 Vincent was elected president by the National Assembly; the embassy profile says he won on the fourth ballot, 30 votes to 19 over his nearest rival Seymour Pradel, for a five-year term. The Gale encyclopedia entry adds that he won the presidency on the strength of his opposition to the U.S. occupation. He was re-elected on 2 June 1935 by universal suffrage, and a constitution submitted to plebiscite automatically extended the presidential term by five years.

body.zh-Hant: 使館資料說他推動公共機構的海地化，1934年最後一批美軍離開海地；Gale 條目說他1934年訪美，說服羅斯福撤出海軍陸戰隊。1935年的再次變更被使館資料形容為毫不遮掩地建立獨裁；1937年多明尼加屠殺海地人時，他的反應被評為軟弱。1941年他不再謀求延長任期、平和退休，由其屬意的繼任者埃利·萊斯科當選，權力交接友好。
body.en: The embassy profile says he orchestrated the Haitianisation of public institutions and that the last American contingent left in 1934; the Gale entry says that in 1934 he visited the United States and convinced Roosevelt to withdraw the Marines. The 1935 change is described by the embassy as installing dictatorship without complex, and his reaction to the 1937 Dominican massacre of Haitians is called weak. In 1941 he decided against another extension, retired peaceably, and his dauphin Élie Lescot was elected; the handover was cordial.

body.zh-Hant: 普恩加萊1860年8月20日生於默茲省的巴勒迪克，1880年12月宣誓成為律師，1883年取得法學博士。1887年7月31日他當選默茲省科梅爾西的共和自由派眾議員，後來擔任公共教育部長與財政部長。他在國會專攻財政問題，巴拿馬醜聞時任財政委員會報告員；1903年2月22日當選默茲省參議員。
body.en: Raymond Poincaré was born on 20 August 1860 at Bar-le-Duc (Meuse), swore the lawyer's oath in December 1880 and took his doctorate in law in 1883. On 31 July 1887 he was elected republican-liberal deputy for Commercy (Meuse) and later served as minister of public instruction and minister of finance. In Parliament he specialised in financial questions and was rapporteur of the finance committee during the Panama scandal; on 22 February 1903 he was elected senator for the Meuse.

body.zh-Hant: 1909年3月18日普恩加萊當選法蘭西學術院院士。1912年1月，他受法利埃之命組閣，自兼外交部長；到1913年1月20日為止同時任總理與外長。他隨後競選總統，1913年2月18日起任共和國總統至1920年2月18日。1914年8月4日他的咨文呼籲「神聖聯盟」，1916年10月13日他前往凡爾登頒授榮譽軍團十字勳章。
body.en: Poincaré was elected to the Académie française on 18 March 1909. In January 1912 Armand Fallières called on him to form a government and he took the foreign affairs portfolio himself, serving as premier and foreign minister until 20 January 1913. He then ran for the presidency and was President of the Republic from 18 February 1913 to 18 February 1920. On 4 August 1914 his message called for the sacred union, and on 13 October 1916 he went to Verdun and presented the cross of the Légion d'honneur.

heading.zh-Hant: 再度出任總理與法郎穩定

body.zh-Hant: 1922年1月至1924年6月，普恩加萊再度任總理兼外交部長，並下令法軍占領魯爾區以索取德國拒付的賠款。1924年6月左翼聯盟獲勝，導致他與總統米勒蘭辭職。1926年7月至1928年11月他又任總理兼財政部長，1928年6月25日國會通過確定「普恩加萊法郎」法定價值的法律。1929年7月27日他因健康辭職，1934年10月15日在巴黎去世。
body.en: From January 1922 to June 1924 Poincaré was again premier and foreign minister, and ordered French troops to occupy the Ruhr to obtain the reparations Germany refused to pay. The victory of the Cartel des gauches in June 1924 brought the resignation of Poincaré and President Millerand. From July 1926 to November 1928 he was premier and finance minister, and on 25 June 1928 Parliament adopted the law fixing the legal value of the Poincaré franc. He resigned for health reasons on 27 July 1929 and died in Paris on 15 October 1934.
